pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.subtitle: Move candidates through your hiring stages.
pipeline.truncatedNote: Showing the {cap} most recent candidates. Refine earlier stages to see the rest.
pipeline.emptyTitle: No candidates in the pipeline yet
pipeline.emptyBody: Applications will appear here as candidates apply and move through your stages.
pipeline.visibleHint: Candidates in this stage are visible to your team.
pipeline.hiddenHint: Candidates in this stage are hidden for your role.
pipeline.inStageDays: {count, plural, one {# day in stage} other {# days in stage}}
pipeline.rollbackBadgeTitle: Rolled back {count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}}
pipeline.notFoundBody: This job has no pipeline, or you do not have access to it.
pipeline.rollbackDescription: Move {handle} back to an earlier stage. They only see a neutral status, never your reason.
pipeline.reasonPlaceholder: Explain why this candidate is moving back…
pipeline.noPriorStages: This candidate is already in the first stage — there is no earlier stage to roll back to.
pipeline.scorecardRequiredHint: Complete at least one scorecard before moving this candidate to the next stage.
pipeline.scorecardBlockedToast: At least one scorecard ({submitted}/{required}) is required before advancing this candidate.
pipeline.scoreBelowThresholdToast: Average score {avg} is below the {threshold} threshold to advance.
pipeline.bulkRejectDescription: You are about to reject {count} candidates. Each applicant will receive a neutral status notification — your reason stays partner-internal.
pipeline.bulkRejectNoteHelp: Partner-internal only — never shown to applicants.
pipeline.bulkAdvanceConfirmTitle: Advance candidates to the next round?
pipeline.bulkAdvanceConfirmBody: Advance {count} candidates to their next round.
pipeline.bulkAdvanceConfirmHint: Candidates that aren't eligible (missing a scorecard or below the score threshold) stay where they are. This can be undone with a rollback.
pipeline.aiInsightStale: {count, plural, one {# candidate} other {# candidates}} waiting over 7 days — consider moving or deciding
pipeline.aiInsightGateBlocked: {count, plural, one {# candidate} other {# candidates}} blocked by scorecard gate — reviews needed to advance
pipeline.aiInsightBusiestStage: "{stage}" has the most candidates ({count}) — this stage may need attention
pipeline.aiInsightFlowing: Pipeline is flowing well — no stale or gate-blocked candidates
